The Patti Classic Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a timeless silhouette and understated elegance. It has premium padded fabric on a wooden slatted base and is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop in every size.

Key features

  • Classic upholstered bed design
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £311.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £363.99; Super King (6FT) £402.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Patti a good choice if I want something simple?

Yes. It has a classic, timeless design that suits most bedroom styles.

Which sizes are available?

Single (3FT) to Super King (6FT), priced from £311.99.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Princess Luxury Bed is a statement upholstered bed frame with a tall, deeply padded headboard, handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, for bedrooms that deserve something special. It sits on a wooden slatted base, from £454.99 in Single 3ft to £584.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Please check dimensions carefully before ordering, as this bed is larger than standard.

Key features

  • Grand princess-scale premium headboard
  • Deeply padded luxury fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £454.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £480.99
  • Double 4ft6: £493.99
  • King 5ft: £519.99
  • Super King 6ft: £584.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage, on a slatted base that suits standard UK mattresses. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99) or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99).

Customisation

Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone fabrics, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Order free swatches to see the finish at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Want something bigger? See the Grand Princess Luxury Bed, or browse upholstered beds and our guide to styling a king size upholstered bed.

FAQ

Is the Princess Luxury Bed bigger than a standard bed?

Yes, it is larger than standard because of the tall headboard, so measure your room before ordering.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £454.99, Small Double 4ft £480.99, Double 4ft6 £493.99, King 5ft £519.99, Super King 6ft £584.99.

Does it have storage?

No, it is a bed frame. For storage see our ottoman beds.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Prism Geometric Bed has an angular geometric headboard shape and sits at the top of our range. Its lines are sharper than the Aurora Fan Panel design, built for bedrooms that want something more architectural.

Key features

  • Angular geometric headboard and matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes

Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Materials & build

Handcrafted in the UK in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame with a slatted base. Choose from Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet. Bespoke fabric and colour requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available so you can compare colours at home.

Delivery & assembly

Delivery across Great Britain is free and made by our own team, usually within 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99 when you order.

Warranty & payment

Every bed comes with a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay. Questions? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

FAQ

How does the Prism differ from the Aurora Fan Panel Bed?

The Prism has sharper, angular lines. The Aurora Fan Panel Bed uses panels arranged in a fan shape.

What sizes does the Prism Geometric Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Contact us to confirm options for this design.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3 to 5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

p3.descriptionHtml:
A bedtime favourite in the making. The Rainbow Kids Bed has a chunky, padded headboard shaped into soft rainbow arches, upholstered in velvet or bouclé in the colour your child chooses.

Key features

  • Chunky quilted rainbow-arch headboard
  • Soft, rounded edges throughout
  • Fully upholstered base to the floor, with no exposed legs
  • Grows with your child, from Single up to Super King
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
